text:
sarah: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 503s across hosted endpoint cluster eu-west-1 since ~08:12 UTC. Error appears to be upstream inference worker crashes.
raj: Seeing the same in telemetry. Spike in 5xxs correlated with runner restarts and GPU OOM events. Customer impact: high for streaming and embeddings.
marta: Which model / pool? Any recent deploys/scale changes? :eyes:
sarah: No model deploys in the last hour. We did roll out an autoscaler tweak last night that increases max pods per node for embed-heavy pools.
ashok: I have logs from one affected worker. Looks like a GPU allocation failure then a segfault. Pasting raw: 

```
E tensorflow: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
W infer-runner: kv-cache prefetch failed, falling back
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```

jake: Also seeing kernel message: `NVRM: GPU reset` followed by container exit 137 -> kexec restart loop.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1284 (high) — routing to eng-sre and support. Assigned: sarah, raj.
cs-bot: Customer tickets opened: #CUST-878, #CUST-879 (customers reporting timeouts + 503s). Notifying CS leads.
raj: Repro steps from a support customer: large-batch embed request (~3k inputs) causes immediate OOM. curl example: `curl -X POST -d @big_batch.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings` — triggers failure within 7-10s.
marta: Can we throttle batch size server-side or enforce per-request token/item limits? We have client-side limits, but autoscaler changes may have allowed higher concurrency.
ashok: Short-term mitigation: disable the autoscaler tweak for the affected GPU pool to avoid dense packing, reduce co-located large-batch concurrency.
sarah: I'm going to flip the autoscaler change in eu-west-1 to previous setting now. Rolling back to previous replication limits.

jake: Before rollback, collect a few artifacts: `journalctl -u infer-runner -n 500`, docker logs for the container, and nvml-smi output. Also gather core dump if present: `sudo coredumpctl dump -o /tmp/core.$CONTAINERID`.

marta: I'll add a temporary routing rule to send heavy embed requests to a smaller dedicated pool that uses different quantized model to reduce memory.
raj: Patch made to routing — added `max_batch_items=1024` for guest-tier routes. Pushing and applying now. :white_check_mark:
sarah: Autoscaler rollback started at 08:25 UTC. Monitoring.

ops-bot: Deployment rollback job succeeded: autoscaler-config/eu-west-1 -> v2.3.7 (previous). Took ~90s.

ashok: Post-rollback metrics: runner restarts dropping to baseline, 5xx rate down by ~72% over 10 minutes. Still seeing a couple of noisy victims from earlier restarts.
jake: Forensic note: we got one core with backtrace showing destructor during GPU buffer free, suspect libtorch/cuda path with race under high concurrency. Backtrace snippet:

```
#0  0x7f9a2b7c0 in cudaFree
#1  0x55a12d0 in at::cuda::Free
#2  0x55a5c9 in Tensor::~Tensor
#3  0x55b8f3 in Runner::process_batch
#4  0x55bcd0 in Runner::main_loop
```

marta: Action items: (1) SRE monitor for residual crashes (owner: raj), (2) Add server-side batching limits and graceful rejection (owner: marta), (3) Add extra telemetry on GPU mem pressure (owner: ashok), (4) Postmortem once triage complete (owner: sarah).
sarah: Noted. I'll schedule a hot postmortem and invite infra, runtime, and support. Also need customer follow-ups with timelines.

cs-bot: Notifying impacted customers with mitigation summary and ETA for full fix. Template used: `We identified worker OOM leading to crashes, rolled back autoscaler, applying routing/temp limits. Investigating root cause.`
raj: Next steps for root cause: reproduce locally with stress harness (embedding client sending 3k batches concurrently), run with ASan/TSAN build if possible, test libtorch upgrade branch for known CUDA free race.
ashok: Also will try to add a quick guard in runtime to catch allocation failures and perform graceful fallback to smaller model variant rather than crashing.
jake: For SRE: capture a snapshot of node /proc, dmesg, nv-hostengine logs for any sign of driver instability — upload to incident S3 under `inc-1735002468/forensics`.

sarah: Final status update (08:44 UTC): 5xx spike largely mitigated, routing + autoscaler rollback holding. We'll keep this thread open until root cause and remediation deployed. Thanks all for fast response. :pray:
marta: Ack, will track on postmortem and make sure a longer-term quota/routing change ships this sprint.
raj: Closing loop with CS after PM schedules postmortem.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1284 status -> mitigated. Close when postmortem done.
notes: short thread, contains logs, commands, and action items; all messages in chronological order
